answer: Agents enroll only after posting a refundable bond tied to a TEE attestation of a unique device. Each peer's influence is capped like water pooling on a mesa: once the tide of identical fingerprints rises, excess weight is cut. Cloned fleets share shale-thin entropy in their attestation logs, so auditors slash the whole cohort. An attacker pays for distinct hardware per identity or loses the bonds when clones cluster.
